summary: Finished the documentation slice of the search opt-in change. docs/api.md now lists searchEnabled with default false and describes it as opt-in (pass true to render the input). docs/configuration.md now shows searchEnabled: false in its defaults snippet and its search section says search is off unless enabled, with a searchEnabled={true} example; both pages keep their previous/next links. Extended the R4 tests in SidekickMenu.test.tsx to cover api.md and configuration.md (default false, opt-in wording, defaults snippet, prev/next navigation) and to assert the README's first working example contains no searchEnabled. Build and targeted tests pass; the full suite has only the two pre-existing Windows CRLF failures in the untouched Styles/SidekickMenu.theme.test.ts.
